# PptxGenJS (NEOMA fork)

> JavaScript/TypeScript library that generates PowerPoint `.pptx` files programmatically in Node.js, browsers, and bundlers. No PowerPoint install required. Output is ECMA-376 OOXML, readable by PowerPoint, Keynote, LibreOffice Impress, and Google Slides.

Install: `npm install @neo-ma/pptxgenjs` (Node.js 20+). Ships ESM + CJS builds and TypeScript types.

```typescript
import pptxgen from "@neo-ma/pptxgenjs"
const pres = new pptxgen()
const slide = pres.addSlide()
slide.addText("Hello", { x: 1, y: 1, fontSize: 24 })
await pres.writeFile({ fileName: "out.pptx" })
```

- [Shapes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NeomaVerwaltung/PptxGenJS/master/docs/api-shapes.md): addShape, shape types, lines
- [Images](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NeomaVerwaltung/PptxGenJS/master/docs/api-images.md): addImage, sizing, paths and base64

- [Charts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NeomaVerwaltung/PptxGenJS/master/docs/api-charts.md): addChart, chart types, axes, series
- [Media](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NeomaVerwaltung/PptxGenJS/master/docs/api-media.md): addMedia, audio, video, YouTube

## Std library

Separate package `@neo-ma/pptxgenjs-std`, published independently. Plain functions over the public API - no runtime dependency on the core, `@neo-ma/pptxgenjs` is a peer used for types only.

- [Std Library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NeomaVerwaltung/PptxGenJS/master/docs/std.md): `grid`/`gridFor` (cell placement instead of absolute inches, throws when out of range), `row`/`column` (divide an area by weights, nestable), `measureText`/`fitText` (real advance widths, so text can be sized to its box), `paginateTable`/`tableFromHtml` (measured multi-slide tables, the alternative to the core's estimating `autoPage`) and `waterfall` (bridge chart via stacked bars)
